title: NoneBot Client
subtitle: Full NoneBot subprocess bridge: environment, adapters, plugin ecosystem and multi-platform messaging — managed autonomously via Web and AI

guide.title: Get started with the NoneBot client
guide.step1: Click the button below to bootstrap the worker environment (isolated venv + NoneBot2, ~1 min)
guide.step2: Install a platform adapter and fill in credentials in the Adapters tab (e.g. OneBot V11 / Telegram)
guide.step3: Enable the NoneBot bridge channel on the Channels page — the worker starts automatically
guide.step4: Browse and install plugins in the Store; the AI can also manage everything via nonebot_* tools

overview.stopWorker: Stop the worker subprocess (can be started again anytime)
overview.interceptOn: Intercept mode: events handled by AI only
overview.passthroughOn: Passthrough mode: plugins and AI both receive messages
overview.noBots: No online bots — connect a platform in the Adapters tab
overview.botsHint: Each connected platform account is listed here; messages route back and forth with sticky routing.
overview.noAdapters: No adapters loaded — install and enable one in the Adapters tab

adapters.emptyHint: Adapter list failed to load or registry unreachable. Retry later.
adapters.uninstallMessage: Uninstall {{name}}? It will be removed from the load list and the worker restarted.

plugins.bridgeDisabledHint: Enable the NoneBot bridge to view loaded plugins.
plugins.emptyHint: Browse the store to install, or ask the AI via nonebot_manage_plugin.
plugins.notLoadedHint: Enabled but not reported by the worker (worker stopped or load failed — see Logs)
plugins.enableToggle: Enabled (off removes from load list, package kept)
plugins.uninstallMessage: Uninstall {{name}}? The worker will restart without it.

store.searchPlaceholder: Search plugins by name / description / author / tags…
store.sourceHint: Powered by registry.nonebot.dev (same source as nonebot.dev/store), showing {{count}} items
store.noResultsHint: Try another keyword or visit nonebot.dev/store/plugins.
store.author: Author
store.advancedInstallHint: For plugins/adapters whose repo code you maintain yourself
store.editable: Editable install (local path, code changes take effect instantly)
store.unvalidatedMessage: Plugin {{name}} has not passed the official NoneBot registry test (may be incompatible or unmaintained). Install anyway?

runtime.title: Worker runtime (isolated venv)
runtime.rebuildMessage: This deletes the entire worker venv and reinstalls baseline packages (installed adapters/plugins must be reinstalled). Continue?
runtime.uvMissingHint: uv not found (falls back to python -m venv, slower). Install via: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
runtime.packagesHint: Restart the worker after upgrading a package for it to take effect
runtime.sourceDesc: PyPI index and proxy for adapter/plugin installs (also applies to git clones); off = force direct. AI can change via nonebot_config_set.
runtime.sourcesNote: Pull & reinstall runs git pull --ff-only per repo (never overwrites your local changes) then force-reinstalls; editable installs apply code changes instantly without reinstall.

env.interceptDesc: When on, platform events go to the AI only (plugins stop responding); when off, plugins and AI both receive messages.
env.envDesc: Key-value pairs written to the worker .env: platform credentials, COMMAND_START and other NoneBot settings.
env.noKeys: No environment variables — use the per-platform forms in the Adapters tab
env.indexDesc: PyPI index used when installing adapters/plugins into the worker venv (self-hosted devpi / mirror). Empty = default.

logs.emptyHint: Worker logs appear here after startup (last 300 lines, 3s refresh).
